appDescription: A curbside pickup coordination and boarding hospitality app for Pleos Connect that aligns driver and passenger on a shared landmark, verifies vehicle model and last-4 plate digits, assists boarding after driver surroundings check, and shreds session links immediately upon completion.

function.name: START_SAFE_PICKUP
function.description: Start a pickup session toward a candidate curbside pickup spot and issue a zero-install passenger web link.

passengerName.description: Display name of the family member or passenger being picked up.

passengerProfile.description: Passenger profile for comfort and car-seat safety rules.

destinationKeyword.description: Pickup place or landmark spoken by the driver.

hasCarSeat.description: Whether a child car seat is installed on the target passenger seat.

function.name: SHARE_PICKUP_OFFSET
function.description: Update and broadcast the stopped vehicle offset relative to the agreed signboard.

function.name: COMPLETE_OR_CANCEL_PICKUP
function.description: Confirm safe passenger boarding or cancel the pickup session, restoring windows/lights and immediately shredding the shared web token.

commandType.description: Lifecycle command for the pickup session.
